question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

To breathe one’s last
solution:
The correct answer is "**To die**". [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• An idiom is a group of words in a fixed order that has a particular meaning that is different from the meanings of each word on its own.

 
 
• For example: Pull someone's leg: to joke with someone.

 
 
• I panicked when she told me the test is today but then I realized that she was just pulling my leg.
 
 
 
 
 
• The given idiom "to breath one's last" means to die.
 
 
• Example: This is the room where my grandfather breathed his last.
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct answer is option 4).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
